premises.text: Early-cycle PCB prototyping via outsourced China fab costs hundreds and takes about two weeks, with rework loops when boards are wrong
premises.evidence_span: Most designers outsource fabrication to facilities in China, pay a couple hundred dollars, and wait two weeks for delivery

premises.text: A printer using silver nanoparticle conductive ink can create a circuit board in roughly lunch-time / under two hours
premises.evidence_span: a printer that can create a circuit board in the time it takes to go get lunch

premises.text: Users design in software they already know and then press print
premises.evidence_span: The user can design their circuit in whatever software they're already comfortable with

premises.text: The printer uniquely supports multi-layer circuits by sandwiching insulating material between conductive layers, and can dispense solder paste and bake boards
premises.evidence_span: We're also the only prototyping tool on the market that allows you to print multi-layer circuits

premises.text: Customers purchase replacement ink cartridges and substrates through the website
premises.evidence_span: our customers will be able to purchase replacement ink cartridges and substrates directly through our website

premises.text: Hardware developers across large tech, startups, academia, and hobbyists need a faster way to prototype electronics
premises.evidence_span: They all agree that hardware developers need a faster way to prototype electronics

value.text: Hardware developers get custom circuits much faster and cheaper toward manufacturing
value.evidence_span: just help people get there faster and save huge costs along the way

secondary_value.text: Press-print custom circuits without toxic hobby etching
secondary_value.evidence_span: if you need custom circuits, just press print

causal_links.evidence_span: With our printer, you need less than two hours
save huge costs along the way
hardware developers need a faster way to prototype electronics
